privacy: Only public group templates, HCP average-area maps and original public atlas are used. No participant-derived image is published.

latest_source_real_input_exact_gate.scope: Correctness gate only; no new speed claims; latest source versus immutable v8 outputs on identical public inputs

protocol.paired_order: Alternating official/candidate and candidate/official; actual CLI old/new additionally recorded
protocol.scope: Full Python worker or official process chain includes startup, complete input load, computation and save; worker eagerly imports Torch. Actual module CLI is a separate protocol.
protocol.worker_inner_scope: Timed adapter.run_case: excludes process startup and common Torch preconfiguration; includes function-specific first imports, complete input load, computation and save. No separate loaded-API repetitions were run.
protocol.cbig_internal_scope: Original CBIG function plus MATLAB MAT serialization; MATLAB startup and Python IO bridges excluded. Different output serialization from FNIT API.
protocol.observations_scope: 20 functional variants: one same-thread observation per variant; no stable speed claim
protocol.cpu_8_is_budget_not_usage: Original MEX k-d tree and other serial steps can use fewer than eight cores; actual per-step effective CPU cores are recorded.

multiframe_scope: Actual official T1 and brain-masked T1 channels from the same template, not independent scans
half_mm_scope: Cubic resampling of original official 1mm template, not independent scan

custom_grid_rounding.scope: Single public HCP average-area input projected to custom 0.5 mm grid; native CBIG supports its own grid only
custom_grid_rounding.interpretation: All observed differences occur at half-voxel coordinates with different nearest-index choices; mask-boundary and nonzero vertex-value differences are included

public_template_lineage.source: FSL original MNI152 T1 and brain-masked T1 templates 2 mm

conclusion.default_grid_and_2mm_inverse: Exact agreement on these tested public inputs
conclusion.trilinear_forward: Float32 interpolation differences; main template left/right relative L2 2.848e-7/2.276e-7
conclusion.custom_half_mm: Half-voxel rounding differs between Torch nearest-even and Workbench floor(voxel + 0.5); never claim strict equivalence for this extension
conclusion.pure_surface_cpu1: New actual CLI remains slower than direct Workbench due to Python/GIFTI validation overhead
conclusion.pure_surface_cpu8: New actual CLI is slightly faster on the tested HCP41k to fsLR32k route with total budget split 4+4
